en.account_assets.library_hint: Save favorites and organize your results into collections. Pick an image to continue creating.
en.account_assets.no_projects: Projects you save in the image editor appear here.
en.account_assets.error: Your work could not be loaded. Try again.
en.account_assets.empty_body: Generated images appear here automatically. You can favorite, organize, download and reuse them.
en.account_assets.library_error: Favorites and collections are temporarily unavailable.
en.account_assets.regenerate_hint: Review the prompt and model before generating
en.account_assets.copy_error: Copy was unavailable. Select and copy the prompt text.
en.account_assets.collection_hint: Group related images so you can return to them later.
en.account_assets.storage_error: Your browser could not save the draft. Copy the prompt and open the generator.
en.account_assets.prompts_body: Practical prompt recipes for your next image. Pick one, adapt it and make it yours.
en.account_assets.skills_body: Ready-made briefs for a specific job. Choose one to put it into your image composer.
en.account_assets.tools_body: A complete workspace for generating, editing and organizing images.
en.account_assets.recipes_note: Images illustrate the recipe themes. Review the draft, add your references and check model availability before generating.
en.account_assets.tools_note: Image operations use your selected model and available credits. Canvas edits and project organization run in the workspace.
en.account_assets.tool_T01_body: Choose an available model and turn a prompt into a new image.
en.account_assets.tool_T02_body: Upload reference images, choose an editing model, and describe the change.
en.account_assets.tool_T03_body: Remove a photo background and download a transparent PNG.
en.account_assets.tool_T04_body: Apply a solid, gradient, uploaded, or generated scene behind a subject.
en.account_assets.tool_T05_body: Create a product shadow with visible direction, blur, opacity, and offset controls.
en.account_assets.tool_T06_body: Relight a photo with a selected lighting setup and optional direction.
en.account_assets.tool_T07_body: Mark an unwanted object and remove only the selected area.
en.account_assets.tool_T08_body: Paint a mask and replace the selected region from a local description.
en.account_assets.tool_T09_body: Choose new boundaries and extend an image without stretching the original.
en.account_assets.tool_T10_body: Upscale an image at 2× or 4× and compare the output dimensions.
en.account_assets.tool_T11_body: Arrange, hide, lock, reorder, and adjust the opacity of image layers.
en.account_assets.tool_T12_body: Place editable text with independent size, color, alignment, and position.
en.account_assets.tool_T13_body: Crop, rotate, resize, and export an image in one focused workspace.
en.account_assets.tool_T14_body: Queue multiple images, follow item-level progress, and retry failed items only.
en.account_assets.tool_T15_body: Export one design to platform sizes with contain, cover, or image extension.
en.account_assets.tool_T16_body: Set a brand name, logo, colors, and fonts for reusable designs.
en.account_assets.tool_T17_body: Create a selected set of white, studio, lifestyle, and ad-layout product images.
en.account_assets.tool_T18_body: Convert PNG, JPG, or WebP artwork into editable SVG paths instead of wrapping a bitmap.
en.account_assets.tool_T19_body: Paste or upload safe SVG markup, recolor it, resize it, and export SVG.
en.account_assets.tool_T20_body: Create a logo brief from brand, industry, style, and graphic type.
en.account_assets.tool_T21_body: Choose a visual template, fill its fields, preview it, and continue editing.
en.account_assets.tool_T22_body: Draw or upload a sketch and pass it as the actual generation reference.
en.account_assets.tool_T23_body: Place numbered notes, arrows, boxes, and brush marks before applying edits.
en.account_assets.tool_T24_body: Build a reusable prompt recipe from variables and share a redacted copy.
en.account_assets.tool_T25_body: Build a visible sequence of image steps with per-step cost and results.
en.account_assets.project_error: This project could not be loaded. It may be unavailable or belong to another account.

zh.account_assets.library_hint: 收藏喜欢的作品，把结果归入合集。选择图片即可继续创作。
zh.account_assets.no_projects: 在图片编辑器保存的项目会显示在这里。
zh.account_assets.empty_title: 从这里开始下一个创意
zh.account_assets.empty_body: 生成的图片会自动保存到这里。你可以收藏、整理、下载，或用它们继续创作。
zh.account_assets.search_hint: 试试其他搜索词或筛选条件。
zh.account_assets.library_error: 收藏和合集暂时无法加载。
zh.account_assets.regenerate_hint: 检查提示词和模型后再生成
zh.account_assets.copy_error: 无法自动复制，请选中提示词文字后复制。
zh.account_assets.collection_hint: 把相关图片放到一起，方便以后继续创作。
zh.account_assets.storage_error: 浏览器无法保存草稿，请复制提示词后打开生成器。
zh.account_assets.prompts_body: 为下一个创意选择实用的提示词配方，再按你的需求调整。
zh.account_assets.skills_body: 针对具体任务准备好的创作说明。选择一个即可填入图片创作框。
zh.account_assets.tools_body: 在一个工作台中完成图片生成、编辑和整理。
zh.account_assets.recipes_note: 配图展示提示词主题。生成前请检查草稿、添加参考图，并确认模型可用状态。
zh.account_assets.tools_note: 图片操作会使用所选模型和可用积分。画布编辑及项目整理在工作台中完成。
zh.account_assets.tool_T01_body: 选择可用模型，把提示词变成图片。
zh.account_assets.tool_T02_body: 上传参考图，选择编辑模型并描述需要修改的地方。
zh.account_assets.tool_T03_body: 提取主体并下载透明背景图片。
zh.account_assets.tool_T04_body: 替换纯色、渐变或 AI 生成的背景。
zh.account_assets.tool_T05_body: 调整阴影的方向、模糊、透明度和位置。
zh.account_assets.tool_T06_body: 用新的光照说明调整图片氛围。
zh.account_assets.tool_T07_body: 选中需要移除的部分，保留其他区域。
zh.account_assets.tool_T08_body: 标记局部区域并描述新的细节。
zh.account_assets.tool_T10_body: 提升现有图片的分辨率。
zh.account_assets.tool_T11_body: 组织图片、文字和背景图层。
zh.account_assets.tool_T12_body: 在画布中加入标题或标注。
zh.account_assets.tool_T14_body: 组织多个编辑任务并查看各项进度。
zh.account_assets.tool_T15_body: 为不同渠道导出合适的尺寸。
zh.account_assets.tool_T16_body: 统一品牌名称、颜色和素材。
zh.account_assets.tool_T17_body: 准备多种场景的产品图片。
zh.account_assets.tool_T18_body: 将图片转换为矢量素材。
zh.account_assets.tool_T19_body: 编辑和检查 SVG 图形。
zh.account_assets.tool_T21_body: 从模板开始组织画布元素。
zh.account_assets.tool_T22_body: 上传草图并说明最终效果。
zh.account_assets.tool_T23_body: 标记图片上的修改位置。
zh.account_assets.tool_T24_body: 把创作目标整理为清晰的提示词。
zh.account_assets.tool_T25_body: 组织可以重复使用的编辑步骤。
zh.account_assets.project_error: 项目无法加载，可能已不可用或不属于当前账户。
